title: About Diversity Collective Ventura County
mission: Providing advocacy, visibility, safety, and wellness for the LGBTQ+ community.
vision: A Ventura County community where LGBTQ+ individuals, inclusive of all intersecting identities, have immediate access to needed services, are celebrated, and treated with equity and respect.
valuesStatement: We believe in the freedom to be your authentic self, both at home & in the community. In lifting each other up even when it's hard, we build allies, opportunities, and resources to live our best lives.
deiStatement: DCVC is committed to fostering, cultivating, and preserving a culture of diversity, equity, and inclusion as we carry out our mission. The collective sum of individual differences, life experiences, knowledge, and self-expression shapes our shared culture.
history: Established in 2014 by community advocates including Steve Somann, Diversity Collective Ventura County was founded to build a dedicated, permanent community resource center and advocacy network for LGBTQIA+ residents in Ventura County. From organizing the coastal Ventura County Pride festival and AIDS Walk Ventura to creating Rainbow Umbrella and Diversity SHINES, DCVC has grown into the region's central sanctuary and community service organization.
